method: SIFT outside active pedestrian boxes expanded3px; direct frame-to-anchor matching; Lowe .75; USAC_MAGSAC 2px
acceptance: inliers>=12, inlier fraction>=.6, inlier p95 residual<=2px, inlier hull>=.02 image area
pixel_convention: Matrices act on one-based MOT footpoints: G_MOT=P(+1,+1) G_SIFT P(-1,-1)
causal_boundary: Each historical transform uses only its own frame and anchor. Future transforms are evaluation-only; no temporal smoothing.
limitations: In-sample residual is not calibration error; approximate global image homography retains parallax and camera-reference uncertainty.
